verdict.rationale: PostHog's AI wizard documents that it can 'migrate you from another vendor', and the CDP 'pulls data in from the tools you already use' and reshapes events as they're ingested. Neither explicitly says historical event data is bulk-imported; the wizard description centres on codebase instrumentation, so this is only a thin, ambiguous match. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk or historical event import feature, documented importers for other analytics tools (e.g. Mixpanel or Amplitude exports), support for file-based data export uploads, backfill timestamp handling, and hands-on corroboration.
